And the admin waits for 4 people cards to be loaded
Then exactly 4 cards are displayed
And the "Опублікувати" button becomes disabled
When the admin remembers the original descriptions and counters of all cards
And the admin clears the "Опис" field of card 1 and enters "Тест коня"
And the admin triggers validation by blurring the "Опис" field of card 1
Then the validation message "Не менше 10 символів" is displayed under the "Опис" field of card 1
And the "Опублікувати" button becomes disabled
When the admin clears the "Опис" field of card 1 and enters "Тест коней"
And the admin triggers validation by blurring the "Опис" field of card 1
Then no validation message is displayed under the "Опис" field of card 1
And the "Опублікувати" button becomes enabled
When the admin clears the "Опис" field of card 2
And the admin triggers validation by blurring the "Опис" field of card 2
Then the validation message "Поле обов'язкове" is displayed under the "Опис" field of card 2
And the "Опублікувати" button becomes disabled
When the admin clears the "Опис" field of card 2 and enters "Тест коней"
And the admin triggers validation by blurring the "Опис" field of card 2
Then no validation message is displayed under the "Опис" field of card 2
And the "Опублікувати" button becomes enabled
When the admin refreshes the page and reopens the "Люди" tab with 4 cards
Then all cards display their original descriptions and counters
And the "Опублікувати" button becomes disabled

Then the validation message "Поле обов'язкове" is displayed under the "Опис" field of card 1
And the "Опублікувати" button becomes disabled

And the "Опублікувати" button becomes disabled
